visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is positioned behind home plate, looking through a black safety net. A batter wearing an orange and white uniform with a black helmet stands in the left-handed batter's box, holding a red bat vertically. Behind him, a catcher in gray and black gear and an umpire in a black shirt are in a crouched position. In the background, a pitcher in a white and blue uniform stands on the dirt mound. The field features bright green grass and a well-maintained brown dirt infield. (2) The pitcher performs a standard overhand delivery, throwing the ball toward the plate. The batter swings with a powerful follow-through, making contact. The camera immediately pans left, tracking the ball's flight through the air. The shortstop and third baseman are visible in their defensive stances before the ball is hit. (3) The camera continues to pan toward the left-field outfield. Two outfielders in white uniforms are seen running toward the green wall. A large electronic scoreboard is visible in the distance, displaying graphics and text. The background beyond the stadium wall shows green trees and a row of tall residential or commercial buildings under a clear, pale sky.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional baseball stadium with green grass, dirt infield, green padded outfield walls with advertisements, and a large electronic scoreboard. Tall buildings are visible in the distance behind the stadium stands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio is dominated by a lively, high-tempo brass melody played by a stadium band, featuring trumpets and rhythmic drums. A large crowd is heard chanting in synchronization with the beat. (2) A sharp, distinct percussive crack occurs, indicating a high-velocity impact. Immediately, the background chanting is replaced by a massive surge in crowd noise, including high-arousal cheering, screaming, and applause. (3) The brass music continues throughout the cheering. The sound mix remains bright and energetic, reflecting a high-excitement sports atmosphere. There is no individual human speech, only collective crowd vocalizations.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To capture a highlights-style moment of a batter hitting a baseball during a professional game, showcasing the atmosphere of the stadium and the reaction of the crowd.
